_readme: Expression set. 'phrase' is what the edit model is asked to change the face to. 'default' marks the ones ticked by default. 'living' marks the ones a living portrait is made of (see npcgen/living.py): blink and talking keep the portrait's own expression and move only the eyes or the mouth.

expressions.label: Neutral
expressions.phrase: a calm, neutral expression with a relaxed mouth

expressions.label: Sad
expressions.phrase: a sad, downcast expression with slightly furrowed brows and a small frown

expressions.label: Angry
expressions.phrase: an angry expression with furrowed brows, narrowed eyes and a tight frown

expressions.label: Surprised
expressions.phrase: a surprised expression with raised eyebrows, wide eyes and a slightly open mouth

expressions.label: Scared
expressions.phrase: a frightened expression with wide eyes and raised worried brows

expressions.label: Disgusted
expressions.phrase: a disgusted expression with a wrinkled nose and a curled upper lip

expressions.label: Laughing
expressions.phrase: laughing out loud with crinkled eyes and a wide open mouth

expressions.label: Tired
expressions.phrase: a tired, sleepy expression with heavy half-closed eyelids

expressions.label: Smug
expressions.phrase: a smug smirk with one raised eyebrow

expressions.label: Embarrassed
expressions.phrase: an embarrassed, shy smile with a slight blush on the cheeks

expressions.label: Thinking
expressions.phrase: a thoughtful expression, only the eyes glancing up and to the side while the head stays exactly where it is, lips gently pressed together

expressions.label: Flirty
expressions.phrase: a playful, flirtatious look with softly narrowed eyes and a teasing half smile

expressions.label: Blink
expressions.phrase: the very same expression as now, but with both eyes fully closed as in the middle of a blink

expressions.label: Talking
expressions.phrase: the very same expression as now, but with the mouth slightly open as if in the middle of saying a word
